spec2def(profmap.dll profmap.spec)

# profmap.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/profmap-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(profmap_shims OBJECT profmap.c)
target_link_libraries(profmap_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(profmap profmap-cargo profmap.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS profmap_shims psdk)
